correctness.rationale: In the pinned proof, with nondegenerate P supported in [0,1], µ,c interior and oracle bet λ* interior of [-c/(1−µ),c/µ], hλ(x)=(x−µ)/(1+λ(x−µ)). Uniform positivity 1+λ(x−µ)≥1−c yields bounded scores/derivatives. The stationarity identity P hλ*=0 implies score variance =P hλ*²=J=−M″(λ*)>0. Fixed score separation and Hoeffding concentration exclude boundary optimizer with exponentially small probability. Local score expansion gives n E(λhat_{n+1}−λ*)²→J^(−1) and n E|λhat−λ*|³→0; Taylor expansion gives nE[M(λ*)−M(λhat)]→1/2. For arbitrary predictable H on [0,1] and fixed κ, the mixture score differs uniformly by O(1/n), so same local limits. Summing one-step deficits by harmonic summation gives (1/2)log N+o(log N). The argument is valid subject to its stated interior/fixed-mass hypotheses; finite Bernoulli examples do not prove it. The public RESULT.md has an unexpanded literal {claim} under its ## Finding header, although its assumptions and proof state the theorem; scientific proof can be assessed but publication must not proceed without a verified full replacement.
